observations.world_result: 0x41c1a5 stores entity 0 for both a world hit and a clear trace; a zero world fraction returns immediately.
observations.replacement: 0x41c0aa..0x41c0dc copies the entire candidate trace when allsolid, startsolid, or a smaller fraction is present. A previous startsolid is not retained across replacement. The corpus uses finite fractions 0, 0.25, 0.5 and 1 with all combinations of solid flags.
observations.owners: 0x41bfbc..0x41bfd7 reads a pass owner only for a positive pass value. 0x41c002 compares the candidate signed state number with passEntityNum. 0x41c012..0x41c02b excludes a candidate whose owner state number equals the pass value, or whose pointer equals the pass entity owner. Sharing an owner alone does not exclude a candidate.
observations.trace_transform: 0x41c048..0x41c074 uses native flag 0x80 to choose current origin/angles or state offsets 88/112. Box angles are replaced with zero.
observations.point_transform: 0x41c2c8 compares the signed state number; 0x41c2d5..0x41c2df always passes state offsets 88/112, without the current-origin flag or a box-angle override.
observations.sweep_bounds: 0x41c1f1..0x41c24c keeps position + extent and the one-unit query pad in x87 PC53 precision until the float store. Forty large-coordinate cases cover rounding differences from binary32 reassociation.
observations.owner_projection_correction: The earlier game-data slice used retail ENTITYNUM_NONE=1023 for an IHV null owner. IHV permits entity number 1023, so the internal projection now uses -1 for null. The native owner remains a pointer; there is no external ABI change.
